fresh_original_opening.title: Hopkins and Gross (1994), Equivariant vector bundles on the Lubin--Tate moduli space
fresh_original_opening.actually_read: Complete original equations (5.3)--(5.8), Proposition 5.7 statement and coefficient congruence; equations (12.1)--(12.9), Proposition 12.10 and its entire printed proof through the final square, including arbitrary residue-field extension. Also the complete displayed Proposition 4.2 proof was returned and read.
fresh_original_opening.scope: Proposition 5.7 attributes integrality to Hazewinkel; no fresh reading of that book is claimed. Original indexed text was read, without page-image inspection.

retained_original_rereading.scope: Original author text, Lemma 2.2.4 and Corollary 2.2.6 with their complete printed proofs, and Theorem 2.2.7 with its complete proof, pp.26--27. The determinant argument in the complete canonical B18 proof and all relevant B62 steps were independently reread.

prior_source_dependencies: The established Tate/Bondarko source validations are reused through the complete canonical B64 coefficient/logarithm/Cartier-projection/actual-graph proof, which was read in full and rederived here. No fresh original Bondarko or Tate read is claimed.

retrieval_failures_retained.resolution: First-engine search recovered the indexed original; complete passages then opened successfully.

retrieval_failures_retained.resolution: Read the already retained original author text, explicitly without claiming a new web opening.
